name: MiniMax-H3 FL2VA
description: MiniMax-H3 FL2VA video-and-audio profile using standalone components.

request_example.prompt: a snowy mountain landscape with pine trees, cinematic wide shot

notes: Set EDGE_DIT_MINIMAX_DIT_PATH, EDGE_DIT_MINIMAX_LLM_PATH, EDGE_DIT_MINIMAX_VIDEO_VAE_PATH, and EDGE_DIT_MINIMAX_AUDIO_VAE_PATH before launching this profile.
MiniMax-H3 requires at least 22 frames and the frame count must satisfy 17k+5.
The preset uses the normal 20-step MiniMax-H3 sampling path; one step is only appropriate for an explicit wiring smoke test.
Generation defaults match benchmark/models/minimax-h3-fl2va.yaml; auto_allocate uses the live free-VRAM budget unless the user supplies a cap.
The output includes generated 32 kHz stereo audio when the audio VAE is configured.
